answer: Reputation-Weighted Inlet Quotas. Each agent may only transact through a whitelisted inlet channel, and channel capacity is allocated proportionally to accrued reputation. New identities start at zero capacity, so clones must first earn reputation through costly honest work. A periodic beacon broadcasts quota snapshots; the sable audit layer flags clusters of identical low-rep behavior and freezes their inlets. Cloning returns nothing until each clone independently pays full onboarding cost.
